note:
Driver smoke test. One cheap cell (4B, TP1, step 0 only) whose purpose is not
its mis_kl but proving the whole path end to end: env generation -> submit -> wait for a
terminal status -> recover the job log -> extract metrics that match TensorBoard -> write
the per-token dump -> have the analysis read it. Every one of those links has failed
silently at least once, and a batch was once reported complete with no job submitted at
all, so the links get verified on real hardware before any measurement run.

cells.name: dump1
cells.note: CP=1, so the dump hook sees full sequences and should write npz files.
